about: Castle Protect v0.1 audio. Made by tools/audio-gen/build.py. Do not edit by hand. See assets/audio/README.md

fields.files: Paths from assets/audio. ogg is Opus (web, Android). m4a is AAC (iOS, old Safari)
fields.duration: Seconds. samples and sample_rate give the exact length: loop over samples 0 to samples, and trim any padding the decoder adds
fields.loop: true: loops with no seam. repeat_gap_s, if set: wait that long between plays
fields.layer: Music layer: base, stir or peril. Layers with the same sync.group are the same length and must start on the same sample
fields.volume: Play gain 0 to 1, before the bus sliders. The files are already set to their mix level
fields.pitch_var_semitones: Shift each play at random by up to this much, up or down
fields.trigger: game: the core event (core/API.md) or UI moment that plays it. anim: the animation event in assets/animations.json as name:event; the sound starts on that frame
fields.lufs_peak: Loudness and peak of the source before encoding

rules: Music sits 8 dB under the loudest impact
An impact ducks music 6 dB (30 ms attack, 400 ms release). hit_blast_tiny does not duck
A bark ducks music 3 dB and world loops 4 dB
At most 16 voices, 3 of one sound within 50 ms
One bark per side per turn step, 1.5 s between barks
No sound before the Play tap on first launch

music_layers.stir: Kettle at 50% or less, or 2 Hobs or fewer on a side, or Squall within 3 rounds
music_layers.peril: Last Hob, or kettle at 25% or less, or Sudden Squall
music_layers.fade: On bar lines, over one bar
